blocks.text: Notifications provide information about events related to components, event information (e.g., high CPU), and relevant values associated with the events. Admins subscribe to receive event notifications from the Zscaler Admin Console. An admin can then filter and view notifications on the Notifications page.
Notifications provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Receive notifications from the Zscaler Admin Console about events that are related to components, event information, and relevant values associated with the events.
Configure events related to component enrollment, component connectivity and upgrades, component usage metrics, system resources, partner federation, and backup configuration.

blocks.text: On the Notifications page (Administration > Alerts > Private Access), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Add a new notification.
Filter the information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied. To learn more, see Using Tables.
View a list of all notifications that are configured for your organization. For each notification, you can see:
Name: The name of the notification.
Click the name to view details for each notification.
Status: Indicates whether the notification is enabled or disabled.
Recipients: The list of email addresses that receive this notification.
Distribution List: The email distribution lists that receive this notification.
Component: The software component category selected.
Categories: The selected events categories.
Priorities: The priority of the notification (i.e., Low, Medium, or High).
Throttling: Indicates whether limits and timeout durations are enforced for the notification.
Software Components: The list of software components to which this notification applies. The name of this label varies based on the component selected (e.g., App Connectors).
Events: The specific events for the selected categories associated with this notification.
Component: The component associated with the notification (i.e., App Connectors, Backup and Restore, or Cloud Connectors).
Categories: The category of the event:
Backup Configuration: Events related to configuration backups and backups that are created manually or automatically.
Connectivity and Upgrade: Events regarding the component connectivity and upgrades.
Enrollment: Events regarding the component enrollment.
Federated Application Configuration: Indicates events related to federated application configurations.
Federated Policy Configuration: Indicates events related to federated policy configurations.
Partner Federation Configuration: Indicates events related to partner federation configurations.
Usage Metrics: Events regarding the component usage metrics.
System Resource: Notifications regarding the component system resources.
The text All appears in this field if all available categories are selected for the notification.
Status: Indicates whether the notification is enabled or disabled.
Refresh the Notifications page to reflect the most current information.
Modify the display of columns in the table.
Copy a notification.
Edit a notification.
Delete a notification.
Notifications that are managed by Zscaler are read only and cannot be edited or deleted.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
